# Belinda

## Overview

- **Age:** 16  <sub>[v2 c27 P45](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0045)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c19 P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054)</sub>
- **Origin:** East Welby  <sub>[v2 c27 P48](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0048)</sub>
- **Role:** Servant / Handmaiden  <sub>[v1 c19 P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054), [v1 c19 P78](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0078), [v2 c21 P39](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0039)</sub>
- **Titles:** Belinda the Fourth  <sub>[v1 c19 P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054), [v2 c21 P39](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0039)</sub>

## Appearance

Belinda is a somewhat strange, small, chubby figure with a freckled face, a very wide mouth, and long, fair hair plaited into pigtails. She is known for her extremely broad, frequent grins and a penchant for wearing large blue ribbon bows.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c19 P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054), [v1 c19 P78](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0078), [v2 c21 P39](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0039), [v2 c25 P43](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0043)_

## Personality

Belinda is an exceptionally cheerful, devoted, and loyal handmaiden who loves her mistress deeply. Although prone to dramatic anxieties and somewhat clumsy around china, she is a hardworking, obedient, and helpful servant who takes great pride in her duties.

_Sources: [v1 c19 P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054), [v1 c19 P70](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0070), [v1 c19 P78](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0078), [v2 c21 P39](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0039), [v2 c21 P44](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0044), [v2 c27 P45](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0045)_

## Traits

- Cheerful and devoted  <sub>[v1 c19 P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054), [v2 c21 P39](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0039)</sub>

## Abilities

- Housekeeping and cooking assistance  <sub>[v1 c19 P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054), [v2 c21 P39](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0039), [v2 c27 P23](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0023)</sub>

## Goals

- To faithfully serve and care for Miss Rosalind  <sub>[v1 c19 P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054), [v2 c21 P45](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0045)</sub>
- To move to Boston with Miss Rosalind and Mr. Stanhope  <sub>[v2 c29 P3](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0003)</sub>

## History

Belinda entered the service of Miss Rosalind Penrose at Echo Cottage as a young girl, becoming the fourth in a line of Bowman sisters to be named 'Belinda' by her mistress. She quickly proved to be a loyal, hardworking, and affectionate handmaiden, assisting in the household and participating in Miss Rosalind's imaginative pursuits. When Nell Harcourt and Isolde Pembroke visited Echo Cottage, Belinda welcomed them warmly and developed a deep admiration for Nell, attempting to imitate her graceful manners. She helped manage the household during Miss Rosalind's courtship and eventual marriage to Stephen Stanhope. Following their wedding, Belinda prepared to move to Boston with the newlyweds to continue serving Miss Rosalind.

_Sources: [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c19 P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054), [v1 c19 P78](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0078), [v2 c21 P39](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0039), [v2 c21 P44](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0044), [v2 c25 P43](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0043), [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 c27 P40](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0040), [v2 c29 P3](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0003)_

## Background by volume

- Her actual name is Leonora Bowman, but she is called Belinda the Fourth by Miss Rosalind after her older sisters
- Hails from East Welby  <sub>[v2 c27 P48](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0048)</sub>
- Entered service at Echo Cottage around age thirteen in exchange for room, board, and garments

> Oh, Miss Harcourt, ma’am, if he’s going away this early there’s nothing into it and never will be.  <sub>[v1 c19 P52](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0052)</sub>

> I don't think a girl needs to be ashamed of being useful, Miss Harcourt, ma'am.  <sub>[v2 c27 P40](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0040)</sub>
